description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Home' that functions as the main page of a recipe application. It includes mock data, fetch logic, state management, UI layout with template syntax, and methods for handling user interactions such as searching, favoriting, and viewing recipe details.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the home page with recipes, search, favorites, and detail modal functionalities.

methods.name: loadRecipes
methods.description: Fetches recipe data from API or uses mock data and updates the component's recipes list.

methods.name: normalizeRecipe
methods.description: Normalizes API data structure into internal recipe object format.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on the search query.

methods.name: persistFavorites
methods.description: Stores the set of favorited recipes into localStorage.

methods.name: $gridX
methods.description: Calculates the x-coordinate for a recipe card based on index for grid placement.

methods.name: $gridY
methods.description: Calculates the y-coordinate for a recipe card based on index for grid placement.

methods.name: $isFavorited
methods.description: Checks if a given recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: $toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by ID.

methods.name: $toggleFavorites
methods.description: Opens or closes the favorites panel.

methods.name: $openDetail
methods.description: Opens the recipe detail modal for the specified recipe ID.

methods.name: pushSearch
methods.description: Simulates adding a character to the current search query.

methods.name: popSearch
methods.description: Removes the last character from the current search query.
